abstract: Unattended interactive autonomy - machines that step into danger in place of humans and complete tasks with human tools - remains a missing capability in mission-critical operations. These domains offer scarce training data and only onboard compute, yet deployed systems must face novelty without erasing prior competence. We introduce Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), which learn efficiently in the lab and continue learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates. CFAM uses a complementary learning architecture with a frozen slow-learning component and a fast-learning Capsule Field. The slow component contains three cortices: Sensor, which maps multimodal input into 3D-grounded geometry; Reasoning, which decomposes tasks into skills and evaluates outcomes; and Action, which executes geometric skills. The Capsule Field stores field learning one-shot and gradient-free as Competence Capsules. Skill installation is few-shot in the lab and continual in the field; open-world novelty is outside scope. We evaluate CFAM across five embodiments: manipulator, quadruped, humanoid, quadrotor, and off-road vehicle. Baselines (pi0, CogACT, SpatialVLA) use the same in-house multi-embodiment dataset for physical-platform comparisons. CFAM reaches the operating point of a standard policy trained on the full prior-training dataset using 40% of the data, or 2.5x fewer trajectories. At test time, autonomous capture of verified near-OOD cases improves action success by 13.9 percentage points. In sequential simulation, backward transfer is -0.5 percentage points versus -11.4 for LoRA. CFAM therefore provides a bounded form of post-deployment physical intelligence: few-shot skill learning, autonomous field growth from verified near-OOD experience, and retention of prior competence.
abstract_zh: 无人值守的互动自主性——机器代替人类进入危险环境并使用人类工具完成任务——仍然是关键任务操作中缺失的一项能力。这些领域提供稀缺的训练数据且仅具备机载计算能力，但已部署的系统必须在不抹去先前能力的情况下面对新颖性。我们提出了持续场适应模型（CFAM），该模型能够在实验室中高效学习，并通过自主、无梯度的设备内更新在部署后继续学习。CFAM采用了一种互补的学习架构，包含一个冻结的慢学习组件和一个快速学习的胶囊场（Capsule Field）。慢组件包含三个皮层：传感器（Sensor），将多模态输入映射到三维基础几何；推理（Reasoning），将任务分解为技能并评估结果；以及行动（Action），执行几何技能。胶囊场以一次性和无梯度的方式存储场学习作为能力胶囊（Competence Capsules）。技能安装在实验室中是少样本的，而在现场是持续的；开放世界的新颖性超出范围。我们在五种实现上评估CFAM：操纵器、四足机器人、人形机器人、四旋翼和越野车。基准（pi0、CogACT、SpatialVLA）使用相同的内部多实现数据集进行物理平台比较。CFAM在使用40%的数据或2.5倍更少的轨迹时，达到了在完整先前训练数据集上训练的标准策略的操作点。在测试时，自动捕获经过验证的近OOD案例使得行动成功率提高了13.9个百分点。在顺序模拟中，反向转移为-0.5个百分点，而LoRA为-11.4个百分点。因此，CFAM提供了一种有限形式的部署后物理智能：少样本技能学习、基于经过验证的近OOD经验的自主场增长，以及对先前能力的保留。

reasons: 非自动驾驶领域排除词占主导

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向部署后物理智能系统的持续场适应方法，通过冻结的基础模型与无梯度快速记忆模块相结合，实现少样本技能学习、现场经验积累和既有能力保持。方法在包括越野车辆在内的多种机器人平台上进行验证，并通过模拟和多平台数据集评估持续学习效果。
title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
title_zh: 持续场适应模型（CFAM）用于部署后的物理人工智能
